apps.localizedDescription: Read the Bible in several translations, search it, mark words, take notes, write documents and prepare Bible studies. Your data stays on your phone. Beta: the iPhone version is new, please report what does not work.

## New in 1.9.33
**Kind of update:** New feature, Mini feature, Improvement
- **[New feature]** **Studying together, chat:** the chat is its own tile with a fixed height; new messages appear at the bottom and scroll into view. The history is stored only on your device, per person: when someone comes back into the room, your earlier chat is there. Turn it on or off or clear it under Settings › My data › Chats.
- **[New feature]** **Friends over the internet:** "Remember as friend" now also works in a room with just the two of you. Afterwards you meet under "Friends" with "Over the internet", no code needed.
- **[New feature]** **Leading through a reading path:** the leader steps through a reading path with Next/Back; everyone sees "Step x of n" and can keep the path. The others' page scrolls along with the leader; your own scrolling briefly takes priority.
- **[New feature]** **Live selection with the same Bible text:** when everyone has the same text open, you see the others' selection and word highlights right on the words, even while they drag.
- **[New feature]** **Sending reading paths and files:** in a room you can send reading paths (optionally with highlights) and files up to 50 MB. The others accept, only view, or decline; nothing opens by itself.
- **[New feature]** **Translation as TXT:** the current translation can be exported completely as TXT, with Strong's numbers, footnotes and headings, and imported again just the same. In a room, "Send translation" sends it to the others.
- **[New feature]** **Message center, deep tour and quiz:** notices stack and can be swiped away; now and then a fitting suggestion appears (can be turned off). A deep tour at John 3:16 shows the whole program with small tasks, and a quiz checks what you learned.
- **[New feature]** **Highlight straight into a folder:** pick a target folder in the vault menu; every new highlight lands there. If the folder has a reading path, the program asks once whether new verses should be appended.
- **[New feature]** **Syncing whole translations over Wi-Fi:** a translation you imported yourself that is missing on the other device now goes across completely during Wi-Fi sync, with Strong's numbers, footnotes and headings. Can be turned off in the sync settings.
- **[Mini feature]** **Tab tours:** on the first start the program asks whether it should show you around; then every tab explains itself the first time it is opened. Switch and reset under Settings › Help.
- **[Mini feature]** **Dragging the side panel:** a visible grip on its edge shows that the right panel can be made wider or narrower; the tours explain it.
- **[Mini feature]** **Status while studying together:** microphone level, camera sign and room time at the bottom show what is going on; a click briefly mutes or pauses the picture. The room code formats itself while you type, and a note shows that everything is end-to-end encrypted.
- **[Mini feature]** **Back button with history on the PC:** as on the phone there is a back button with a clock; a right click shows the places you visited last. Settings are split into clearer tiles, and read-aloud voices are only offered where they work.
- **[Improvement]** **Camera and sound:** the camera now sends a video stream, up to Full HD at 30 or 60 frames per second; call audio runs at 48 kHz and the pointer glides smoothly. Everyone in the room needs version 1.9.33 for this.
- **[Improvement]** **Layouts:** the ready-made layouts at the top right are redone, each with a short description: Reading (just the text, full screen), Study, Word study, Writing, Sermon, Bible class, Together and Dashboard. Your own layouts now also keep the split view and word study.
- **[Improvement]** **Parallel view:** reading paths, word study, highlighting and the full verse menu now work in every column, even when the columns scroll on their own; the translation's headings appear there too.
- **[Improvement]** **Phone:** scrolling no longer selects anything, holding opens a menu only after a calm moment, the explorer lets you tick several entries by tapping, documents and notes scroll as a whole, the continue tiles and graphs fit the screen better (zoom with two fingers), and many areas are more compact (documents, search, explorer; the keyboard no longer covers the input field).

**iPhone:** update in SideStore (Sources → pull down → My Apps → Update). **Android:** the app updates itself.

## New in 1.9.32
**Kind of update:** New feature, Mini feature
- **[New feature]** **Studying together across networks:** one person creates a room and gets a short room code; up to five people join, on the same Wi-Fi, on mobile data or somewhere else entirely. Everything is end-to-end encrypted and passes through a small relay of our own that cannot read it. The room code is now the default; studying together on the same network works as before. You are asked once more for your consent the first time.
- **[Mini feature]** **Daily limit:** a note explains that the free relay has a daily limit and what still works then: the same network or a shared ZeroTier network.
- **[Mini feature]** **Camera in HD:** the camera when studying together now sends 720p by default, with a choice of low/medium/HD and noticeably less delay.

**iPhone:** update in SideStore (Sources → pull down → My Apps → Update). **Android:** the app updates itself.

## New in 1.9.31
**Kind of update:** New feature, Mini feature, Fix
- **[New feature]** **Bible passages as links:** a link like `biblestudy://Joh3,16` (in WhatsApp, e-mail, Obsidian or on a web page) opens the passage right in BibleStudy; several passages become a list. The verse menu has "Copy link to the passage (opens BibleStudy)". On Android, "Share → BibleStudy" and "BibleStudy" in the menu of a text selection work too.
- **[New feature]** **Words of Jesus (red letters) for imported Bibles:** importing takes over the red-letter words a file marks (OSIS, USFM, USX, Zefania, e-Sword, MySword, web pages, EPUB, Word). Translations without their own marks get them estimated verse by verse from the KJV; can be switched off in the settings.
- **[New feature]** **Install update file:** under Settings › Updates and program you can install a test version you received as a file (`.bsupdate`). Your data is backed up first, and if anything goes wrong the previous version comes back by itself.
- **[Mini feature]** **Patch notes after an update:** they open by themselves after the restart; a switch under Updates and program turns this off.
- **[Mini feature]** **iPhone widgets:** the round button on the lock screen shows the BibleStudy symbol, and "Due today" stays readable on the tinted home screen.
- **[Fix]** **iPhone:** the start page shows two columns of books again after the app starts.

**iPhone:** update in SideStore (Sources → pull down → My Apps → Update). **Android:** the app updates itself.

## New in 1.9.30
**Kind of update:** New feature, Mini feature, Fix
- **[Fix]** **iPhone widgets:** the BibleStudy button under the clock and "Verse of the day" did not show up in the widget gallery. The widget extension is now built with Xcode, so iOS finds it. When SideStore asks about the extension during the update, choose "Keep App Extensions (for Each Extension)"; "Use Main Profile" leaves the widgets empty.
- **[New feature]** **Earlier versions:** documents (menu "⋯") and notes (button "Earlier versions") keep what their text was before, at most one version every 10 minutes and the last 50. View them and bring one back with a click; the current text is kept as a version. Versions stay on each device.
- **[Mini feature]** **Cross reference star:** nodes can be dragged, "Second ring" shows the links between the neighbours, "Reset layout" puts them back in a circle.
- **[Mini feature]** **Syntax tree as SVG:** "Save as SVG" next to "Save as picture", sharp at any size for slides and handouts.

**iPhone:** update in SideStore (Sources → pull down → My Apps → Update). **Android:** the app updates itself.

## New in 1.9.29
**Kind of update:** Feature
- **[New]** Android: a widget for the home screen shows the verse of the day and today's reading from your plan with its progress. A tap on the verse opens it, a tap on the plan opens the reading.
- **[New]** iPhone: a button for the lock screen, under the clock, that starts BibleStudy, and a "Verse of the day" widget with your reading plan for the home and lock screen (iOS 17 or later). The widgets come as an extension that counts as one more app with a free Apple ID; leave it out when SideStore asks if you need the slot.
- **[New]** The widgets change to the next verse at midnight, also when the app has not been opened; they fill once you have opened BibleStudy after the update.

**iPhone:** update in SideStore (Sources → pull down → My Apps → Update). **Android:** the app updates itself; add the widget by holding a free spot on the home screen → Widgets → BibleStudy.
